modelRecommendation.interpolation: clamp(effectiveSkill/278,0,1); convex blend zero-skill baseline and the input-rank-specific published vector
assumptions: The reported 105+28 skill is treated as native skill before the matching specialization bonuses. The source did not give a normalized operation-info field.
Current pinned skill allocations interpret historical maxed tree as matching root30 and child30; historical trait amounts/build applicability are unverified.
Linear skill-to-quality interpolation is a working model, not a measured intermediate skill curve.
Input rank1 remains three rank1 dust because the input-rank quality cap precludes higher ranks.
The native label route for Skill does not by itself justify transferring gear-disenchant quantity procs to this fixed-three-output recipe.
modelRecommendation.massConservation: Every cohort and every convex interpolation totals exactly three Dust per completed cast. Resourcefulness changes expected shard consumption; it must not multiply Dust per cast.
forbiddenInferences: Do not derive per-output hit probability, output stack histogram, or extra source casts from these unit totals.
Do not interpret initial 1000-shard inventory as the completed-cast denominator.
Do not combine unknown-cast858/2820-inventory anecdotes with these controlled denominators.
